shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' -g '"'!*lock*'"' -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' -g 'pages/**' -g 'index.html' -g '*config*' -g 'README*' -g 'public/**' -g 'components/**' -g '*css' -g '*tsx' -g '*jsx' -g '*ts' -g '*js'"
/bin/bash -lc 'ls -la && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat index.html && find .. -name AGENTS.md -print'
/bin/bash -lc "cat tsconfig.json && ls node_modules | rg 'playwright|puppeteer|lucide' && ls __agent_eval__"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'
/bin/bash -lc "rg 'font-family|background' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css -m 5 && git diff --stat"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm exec --yes --package=@playwright/test -- playwright --version'
/bin/bash -lc "npm exec --yes --package=@playwright/test -- playwright screenshot --browser chromium --viewport-size '1440,1080' --full-page http://localhost:5173 /tmp/forma-desktop.png"
/bin/bash -lc "rg --files /root/.npm/_npx /home/node/.npm/_npx /home/sandbox/.npm/_npx -g 'package.json' -g 'playwright.js' 2>/dev/null | head -20"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm exec --yes --package=@playwright/test -- playwright install chromium'
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css && git status --short"
/bin/bash -lc "mkdir -p public && curl -L --fail --max-time 20 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1472099645785-5658abf4ff4e?w=160&h=160&fit=crop&crop=faces' -o public/avatar.jpg"

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module -e \"import {writeFile} from 'node:fs/promises'; const response = await fetch('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1472099645785-5658abf4ff4e?w=160&h=160&fit=crop&crop=faces'); if ("'!response.ok) throw new Error('"'Avatar download failed'); await writeFile('public/avatar.jpg', Buffer.from(await response.arrayBuffer()));\""
/bin/bash -lc 'which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome python3 && cat .gitignore'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .gitignore && npm exec --yes --package=prettier -- prettier --write src/App.tsx src/styles.css index.html'
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '140,290p' src/App.tsx && sed -n '520,650p' src/App.tsx"
/bin/bash -lc 'ls -lh public/avatar.jpg && npm exec --yes --package=prettier -- prettier --write src/App.tsx src/styles.css'
/bin/bash -lc 'ls /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright && npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -i 's/launch({headless: true})/launch({headless: true,executablePath:chromium.executablePath()})/' /tmp/forma-check.mjs
node /tmp/forma-check.mjs"
/bin/bash -lc 'command -v apt-get; command -v sudo; command -v nix; command -v ldd; ls /usr/lib /usr/bin | head -30; cat /etc/os-release'
/bin/bash -lc 'id && ls /var/lib/apt/lists | head -10 && ldd /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1248/chrome-linux-arm64/chrome'

/bin/bash -lc 'mkdir -p /tmp/forma-browser-deps && cd /tmp/forma-browser-deps && apt-get download libglib2.0-0 libnspr4 libnss3 libatk1.0-0 libatk-bridge2.0-0 libdbus-1-3 libcups2 libxkbcommon0 libasound2 libgbm1 libcairo2 libpango-1.0-0 libxcomposite1 libxdamage1 libxfixes3 libxrandr2 libatspi2.0-0 libdrm2 libharfbuzz0b libthai0 libpixman-1-0 libcairo-gobject2 libxrender1 libdatrie1 libgraphite2-3 libfribidi0 libfontconfig1 libfreetype6 libpng16-16 libbrotli1'

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module -e \"import {writeFile} from 'node:fs/promises'; const response = await fetch('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/main/ofl/golostext/OFL.txt'); if(response.ok) await writeFile('public/fonts/OFL.txt',await response.text());\""
/bin/bash -lc 'npm exec --yes --package=prettier -- prettier --write src/App.tsx src/styles.css index.html && ls -lh public/fonts'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat public/fonts/golos.css && git diff --check && git status --short'

/bin/bash -lc 'for file in /tmp/forma-browser-deps/*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$file" /tmp/forma-browser-deps/extracted; done
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/forma-browser-deps/extracted/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu ldd /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1248/chrome-linux-arm64/chrome | rg '"'not found'"

/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/forma-browser-deps && apt-get download libavahi-common3 libavahi-client3 libwayland-server0 libxcb-shm0 libxcb-render0 libxi6 && for file in *.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$file" /tmp/forma-browser-deps/extracted; done
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/forma-browser-deps/extracted/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/forma-browser-deps/extracted/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu node /tmp/forma-check.mjs'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -i 's/launch({headless: true,executablePath:chromium.executablePath()})/launch({headless: true})/' /tmp/forma-check.mjs
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/forma-browser-deps/extracted/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/forma-browser-deps/extracted/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu DEBUG=pw:browser node /tmp/forma-check.mjs"

/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/forma-browser-deps && apt-get download libsqlite3-0 fonts-dejavu-core fontconfig-config && for file in *.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$file" /tmp/forma-browser-deps/extracted; done
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/forma-browser-deps/extracted/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/forma-browser-deps/extracted/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu FONTCONFIG_PATH=/tmp/forma-browser-deps/extracted/etc/fonts node /tmp/forma-check.mjs'
/bin/bash -lc 'ls -l /tmp/forma-*png'
/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module -e \"import {readFile} from 'node:fs/promises'; const b=await readFile('public/fonts/golos-0.ttf'); console.log(b.slice(0,100).toString());\""

/bin/bash -lc "sed -i \"s/await browser.close();/console.log(await page.evaluate(()=>[...document.styleSheets].flatMap(s=>{try{return [...s.cssRules].filter(r=>r.cssText.includes('Golos')).map(r=>r.cssText.slice(0,700))}catch{return []}})));await browser.close();/\" /tmp/font-check.mjs
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/forma-browser-deps/extracted/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/forma-browser-deps/extracted/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu node /tmp/font-check.mjs"

/bin/bash -lc "cat > /tmp/forma-fonts.conf <<'EOF'
<?xml version=\"1.0\"?><"'!DOCTYPE fontconfig SYSTEM "fonts.dtd"><fontconfig><dir>/tmp/forma-browser-deps/extracted/usr/share/fonts</dir><cachedir>/tmp/forma-font-cache</cachedir></fontconfig>
EOF
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/forma-browser-deps/extracted/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/forma-browser-deps/extracted/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu FONTCONFIG_FILE=/tmp/forma-fonts.conf node /tmp/forma-inspect.mjs'

/bin/bash -lc 'rm public/fonts/golos-0.ttf public/fonts/golos-1.ttf public/fonts/golos-2.ttf public/fonts/golos-3.ttf public/fonts/golos-4.ttf
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/forma-browser-deps/extracted/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/forma-browser-deps/extracted/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu FONTCONFIG_FILE=/tmp/forma-fonts.conf node /tmp/forma-check.mjs'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -i \"/await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Открыть меню'}).click();/a await page.waitForTimeout(250);\" /tmp/forma-check.mjs
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/forma-browser-deps/extracted/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/forma-browser-deps/extracted/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu FONTCONFIG_FILE=/tmp/forma-fonts.conf node /tmp/forma-check.mjs"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n '"'^'"\\.(breadcrumbs|page-heading p|tabs button|section-heading h2|section-heading p|field > span|field input,|select-wrap select|setting-copy label|setting-copy p|checkbox-row strong|checkbox-row small|profile-tip > p|privacy-card p|save-status|security-note|nav-item|subnav button|avatar-buttons|avatar-row)' src/styles.css"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '520,552p' src/styles.css && sed -n '625,655p' src/styles.css && sed -n '723,745p' src/styles.css && sed -n '826,869p' src/styles.css && sed -n '1020,1080p' src/styles.css"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -i \"/await page.setViewportSize({width:390,height:844});/a await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo(0,0));\\nawait page.waitForTimeout(300);\" /tmp/forma-check.mjs
npm exec --yes --package=prettier -- prettier --write src/App.tsx src/styles.css index.html
npm run build
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/forma-browser-deps/extracted/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/forma-browser-deps/extracted/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu FONTCONFIG_FILE=/tmp/forma-fonts.conf node /tmp/forma-check.mjs"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && git status --short && ls -lh public/fonts'
